description: This file defines an event controller class 'CustomField' within the OpenCart admin system. It contains methods to handle adding, editing, and deleting custom fields, primarily by scheduling tasks related to customer groups whenever these events occur.

classes.name: CustomField
classes.description: Event controller class handling custom field related events in OpenCart admin system.

methods.name: addCustomField
methods.description: Handles event after adding a custom field, schedules tasks for each customer group based on output.

methods.name: editCustomField
methods.description: Handles event after editing a custom field, schedules tasks for customer groups.

methods.name: deleteCustomField
methods.description: Handles event after deleting a custom field, schedules tasks for affected customer groups.
